automatable_note: Brake and battery setup start with a press of the ESC on/off button (battery setup: hold 4-5 s, red LED out). The button is not a throttle or power action.

manual.action: Press the ESC's on/off button: once for brake setup; held 4-5 s, until the red LED goes out, for battery setup.
Battery setup: press the button to step the type, read it on the blue LED; hold it 2-3 s to store.

entry.confirm_signal: Three beeps after the button press with the stick at the brake position.
steps: Transmitter on, stick at brake position (towards you).
Press the ESC on/off button: 3 beeps (brake setup state).
Move stick to full power: 5 beeps; wait 5 s: 7 beeps.
Move stick to the brake position while the wanted count sounds.

announce.description: At full power the motor beeps 5 times; after 5 s it beeps 7 times. The operation section reads 5 beeps as brake on and 7 beeps as brake off.

select.description: Return the stick to the brake position to choose the state being announced. Three beeps follow: the ESC is ready.

scheme.confirm_signal: Three beeps after the stick returns to the brake position.
scheme.exit: Setting is kept after the ESC is switched off.
scheme.description: A press of the on/off button with the stick at brake gives 3 beeps. Full power gives 5 beeps, then 7 beeps after 5 s. Returning the stick to brake stores the state announced and gives 3 beeps. Repeating the process switches back.

items.name: Brake
items.note: Value numbers are the beep counts at full power.

items.name: Battery type
items.note: Set with the button and the blue LED only; the manual gives no beeps for this item.

unknowns: Duration, gap and pitch of the 3, 5 and 7 beeps: not stated.
Whether the 5 s wait between the 5-beep and 7-beep announcements is exact: manual says 'wait 5 seconds'.
Which stick position selects brake on versus brake off: the setup section says move to brake to finish; the operation section reads 5 as brake on and 7 as brake off.
Whether the brake announcement loops after 7 beeps: not stated.
notes: Setup step 1 says the factory brake default is 'brake on'; step 4 of 'ESC OPERATION' reads 5 beeps as brake on and 7 as brake off, consistent with the table above, while the brake setup text only says 'switch the brake on, repeat the process'.
